A saved recovery code can also be used to sign in and reset if settings page not reachable. Part 3 says re-enrolling invalidates old QR code entirely.

arguments.message:
To get back in, open **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**, tap **Reset**, and then set it up again just like a first‑time enrollment:
1. Scan the new QR code with your authenticator app.
2. Enter the six‑digit code it generates to confirm.
3. Save the new recovery codes you’re shown.
If you can’t reach the settings page, you can sign in with a saved recovery code and then reset from there.
